summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline with text TF-IDF extraction, LightGBM, and proper out-of-fold stacking. However, the code ultimately crashes due to a pandas TypeError when manipulating categorical columns. Methodologically, the solution leaks test data into the training process by fitting the TF-IDF vectorizer and computing grouped statistics on the combined dataset, and ignores both the temporal and user-grouped nature of the data during cross-validation.
